title: Pass a value through a channel
summary: Go: Pass a value through a channel. Send 6 instead.
introduction: A channel carries values between parts of a program. A buffered channel can hold one value here.
learningObjectives: Pass a value through a channel with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.
Pass a value through a channel

blocks.title: Pass a value through a channel
blocks.code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
scores := make(chan int, 1)
scores <- 8
fmt.Println(<-scores)
}

blocks.text: The buffer holds one int. The send puts 8 in it; the receive takes 8 out.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An unbuffered send needs a receiver ready, or it will wait.
